import numpy as np
from PIL import Image

im26 = np.array(Image.open('/work/observations/obs_0026.png'))
# For each column u, find max v where color is brown (R > 80, G > 30, B < 50)
brown_mask = (im26[:,:,0] > 70) & (im26[:,:,1] > 30) & (im26[:,:,1] < 100) & (im26[:,:,2] < 50)

# Group connected components of the legs below the seat (v > 330)
legs_mask = brown_mask & (np.arange(512)[:, None] > 335)
import scipy.ndimage as ndi
lbl, num = ndi.label(legs_mask)
print(f"Found {num} leg components")
for i in range(1, num+1):
    c = np.argwhere(lbl == i)
    v_max = c[:,0].max()
    foot = c[c[:,0] == v_max]
    u_cen = (foot[:,1].min() + foot[:,1].max()) / 2.0
    print(f"Leg {i}: foot at v={v_max}, u={u_cen}, size={len(c)}")
